notes.title: Ready to release.
notes.content:
"Did I ever tell you what is the definition of insanity is ... Insanity is doing the exact ... same fucking thing ... over and over again expecting ... shit to change ... That. Is. Crazy." - It's not a game, it's a concentrated madness. Try, die and try. Again, and again. Again and again ... Become insane.

If you are a curator, if you have strong nerves, if you are a hardcore player - write to me. I'll send you a copy. Let's see what you're capable of.
